run_environment.mathematical_protocol: Foundation 13 high-gradient v2 MMS copied without changing equations, forcing, end time, mesh matrix, time steps, or gates
run_environment.scope: Foundation 14 five-case successor matrix; not a solver-version defect verdict or continuous-extrema certificate

case_diagnostics.note: Diagnostics only. Analytic peaks are evaluated at cell centers, not continuous extrema.

interpretation: Compare identical manufactured inputs and measured outputs case by case. Version agreement or disagreement is descriptive; it does not by itself validate either solver or establish a defect.
limitations: Standard solver acceptance and sampled local numerical quality are separate verdicts.
A coarse-grid local failure alone is classified as underresolution, not a solver defect.
Cell-center derivative extrema are sampled diagnostics, not continuous extrema certificates.
No inference about singularity, blow-up, molecular alignment, physical hazard, or constitutive viscosity follows from this benchmark.
